stories.title: Saudi crown prince, Italian PM emphasize importance of supporting efforts to ensure freedom of navigation

en.title: Saudi crown prince, Italian PM emphasize importance of supporting efforts to ensure freedom of navigation
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni discussed maritime security and freedom of navigation in vital waterways during a phone call. The leaders also reviewed bilateral cooperation between their nations and recent regional developments.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Italian PM Meloni emphasize security of navigation in phone call

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Italian PM Meloni emphasize security of navigation in phone call
en.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni discussed bilateral cooperation and regional developments during a telephone conversation. Both leaders stressed the importance of ensuring freedom of navigation in vital waterways to enhance regional stability.

stories.title: Crown Prince discusses regional developments during call with Qatari Emir

en.title: Crown Prince discusses regional developments during call with Qatari Emir
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke by phone with Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani to review bilateral relations and regional developments. The two leaders discussed efforts to achieve security and stability in the region.

stories.title: Crown Prince, UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Discuss Bilateral Relations, Regional Developments

en.title: Crown Prince, UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Discuss Bilateral Relations, Regional Developments
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman held discussions with UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed regarding bilateral relations and regional developments.

stories.title: Crown Prince Discusses Regional Developments with Qatari Emir

en.title: Crown Prince Discusses Regional Developments with Qatari Emir
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince held discussions with Qatar's Emir regarding regional matters.

stories.title: Fitch: Saudi stock market remains Gulf’s largest, commands 63% market share

en.title: Fitch: Saudi stock market remains Gulf's largest, commands 63% market share
en.summary: The Saudi stock market held the largest capitalization in the Gulf region in September 2026 with a 63 percent share, while most listed entities maintained investment-grade ratings.

stories.title: Crown Prince meets UAE Vice President in Riyadh

en.title: Crown Prince meets UAE Vice President in Riyadh
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince met with the UAE Vice President in Riyadh to review bilateral relations and discuss regional developments, with attendance from Saudi Arabia's Defense Minister.

stories.title: 100 days to go: Saudi Arabia showcases readiness for AFC Asian Cup 2027

en.title: 100 days to go: Saudi Arabia showcases readiness for AFC Asian Cup 2027
en.summary: With 100 days remaining before the AFC Asian Cup 2027 begins on January 7, Saudi Arabia's organizing committee confirmed that tournament preparations have moved from planning into full operational status.

stories.title: Saudi crown prince welcomes UAE vice president in Riyadh

en.title: Saudi crown prince welcomes UAE vice president in Riyadh
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met with UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan in Riyadh to discuss bilateral relations and regional developments, with greetings exchanged between leadership.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince reaffirms Kingdom’s support for Sudan’s stability, sovereignty

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince reaffirms Kingdom's support for Sudan's stability, sovereignty
en.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke with Sudan's Transitional Sovereignty Council President to reaffirm Saudi Arabia's commitment to Sudan's stability, sovereignty, territorial integrity, and efforts to restore stability and facilitate refugee returns.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince Receives Call from Sudan’s Transitional Sovereign Council President

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince Receives Call from Sudan's Transitional Sovereign Council President
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman received a call from Sudan's Transitional Sovereign Council President.

stories.title: Saudi crown prince to Al-Burhan: Saudi Arabia fully supports Sudan's stability

en.title: Saudi crown prince to Al-Burhan: Saudi Arabia fully supports Sudan's stability
en.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke with Sudan's Transitional Sovereignty Council Chairman Abdel Fattah Al-Burhan, reaffirming Saudi Arabia's support for Sudan's stability, sovereignty, territorial integrity, and comprehensive development efforts.

stories.title: ‎CMA seeks public input on earnings call controls

en.title: CMA seeks public input on earnings call controls
en.summary: The Capital Market Authority is requesting feedback on draft regulations for earnings calls, with a 30-day consultation period ending October 29, 2026. The proposed rules aim to enhance disclosure and transparency between listed companies and investors regarding financial results.

en.title: Amwaj International details 5 lawsuits seeking SAR 67.9M
en.summary: Amwaj International has filed five lawsuits in commercial courts to recover outstanding receivables and financial claims totaling SAR 67.9 million from customers.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Fisheries appoints Mansour Al-Sagheer as Chairman

en.title: Saudi Fisheries appoints Mansour Al-Sagheer as Chairman
en.summary: Saudi Fisheries appointed Mansour Al-Sagheer as Chairman and Abdulilah Al-Wabel as Vice Chairman on September 29, 2026, following the resignation of previous Chairman Abdulaziz Al-Humaid.

stories.title: ‎CMA approves changes to auditor registration rules

en.title: CMA approves changes to auditor registration rules
en.summary: The Capital Market Authority approved amendments to auditor registration rules effective September 29, introducing stricter professional qualification requirements for registered accounting firms and their audit managers.

en.title: AWPT wins SAR 80M contract with KFIA
en.summary: Alkhorayef Water and Power Technologies Company secured an SAR 80 million contract to rehabilitate water infrastructure at King Fahad International Airport. The 18-month project will be executed by Dammam Airports Company.
